This slice keeps rows for about 50 visual novels: vn, vn_titles, releases, releases_titles,
releases_platforms, releases_vn, releases_producers and producers. Title strings are catalogue
titles, not excerpts. Descriptions, images, tags, traits, characters, votes, staff notes and
quotes are omitted. The dump has no territory column. A release language row may have a null
title; the language is still recorded.
